006package dev.metaschema.core.model.util;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.StaticContext;
009import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.StaticMetapathException;
010import dev.metaschema.core.model.IModule;
011import dev.metaschema.core.model.ModelInitializationException;
012import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014
015/**
016 * Provides utility methods for parsing qualified names within Metaschema
017 * modules.
018 */
019public final class ModuleUtils {
020  /**
021   * Parse a flag name.
022   * <p>
023   * The namespace for the name will be determined according to
024   * {@link StaticContext#parseFlagName(String)}.
025   *
026   * @param module
027   *          the containing module
028   * @param name
029   *          the name
030   * @return the parsed qualified name
031   */
032  @NonNull
033  public static IEnhancedQName parseFlagName(
034      @NonNull IModule module,
035      @NonNull String name) {
036    try {
037      return module.getModuleStaticContext().parseFlagName(name);
038    } catch (StaticMetapathException ex) {
039      throw new ModelInitializationException(ex);
040    }
041  }
042
043  /**
044   * Parse the name of a field or assembly.
045   * <p>
046   * The namespace for the name will be determined according to
047   * {@link StaticContext#parseModelName(String)}.
048   *
049   * @param module
050   *          the containing module
051   * @param name
052   *          the name
053   * @return the parsed qualified name
054   */
055  @NonNull
056  public static IEnhancedQName parseModelName(
057      @NonNull IModule module,
058      @NonNull String name) {
059    try {
060      return module.getModuleStaticContext().parseModelName(name);
061    } catch (StaticMetapathException ex) {
062      throw new ModelInitializationException(ex);
063    }
064  }
065
066  private ModuleUtils() {
067    // disable construction
068  }
069
070}
